description: This Java source file defines a custom Android widget class 'ThumbnailRadioButton' that extends 'RadioButton'. The class customizes the button to display a thumbnail image along with a focus rectangle, managing different visual states (checked and unchecked) with layered drawables. It overrides default button behavior to provide a visual representation suitable for selecting images with thumbnails, integrating custom background drawables and padding adjustments.
